Promotion of Diversity Policy
Stanbic Holdings Plc recognises the
importance of, and value added by diversity in
the composition of a Board of Directors. As a
Group with operations in several jurisdictions,
we recognise that diversity of skills, experience,
background, knowledge,culture, race and gender
strengthens the board’s ability to effectively
carry out its duties and add value to the group.
It mitigates the risk of ‘group think’ and
improves the group’s resilience. This policy
seeks to articulate the group’s approach
regarding the promotion of diversity on
its Boards of Directors in compliance with
the CMA Corporate Governance Code
and King IV Report, and must specifically
consider the promotion of gender, age, skills,
ethnic and race diversity. The Promotion
of Diversity Policy is reinforced by the
diversity considerations set out in the Board
Succession Planning Policy.
Group Stakeholder Engagement Guidelines
The Group recognises that effective stakeholder
engagement is essential to achieving our purpose
“Kenya is our home, we drive her growth”. It is also
the heart of our Values and Code of Ethics.
Stakeholder engagement maintains and strength
our legitimacy and social licence to operate, build
trust with stakeholders and enhances our reputat
as a socially relevant and responsible corporate
citizen wherever we operate. We have a responsib
to minimise any harmful impacts and optimise
the positive impacts on our stakeholders. These
Guidelines are intended to assist and guide Group
entities in their stakeholder engagement activities
based on the Group’s stakeholder engagement
principles.
